subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): add timeouts to model discovery requests

question: Should Amazon Bedrock discovery abandon each control-plane request after 30 seconds and return its existing fallback result?
rationale: The pinned SDK supports cancellation and the implementation is narrow, but selecting a fixed real-service latency cutoff is an availability policy tradeoff that fake timers cannot settle.

options.title: Calibrate and prove
options.body: Require provider-area acceptance plus redacted stalled and successful discovery evidence before merging the fixed deadline.

options.title: Accept the cutoff
options.body: Merge with explicit acceptance that Bedrock control-plane responses slower than 30 seconds are treated as discovery failures.

recommendation.title: Calibrate and prove
recommendation.body: Require provider-area acceptance plus redacted stalled and successful discovery evidence before merging the fixed deadline.
